objective: Ship a greenfield Tauri + Rust desktop app for encrypted point-to-point peer chat over HTTP, with GraphPact installed as the project lifecycle.
non_goals: No group/mesh chat or multi-peer rooms
No central relay, discovery service, or Tor integration
No mobile packaging in this change
No password-based key recovery or cloud key backup
No PKI / certificate pinning on first connect (TOFU over HTTP is accepted for v0)
grill: User asked for HTTP point-to-point P2P: each peer exposes a local HTTP API and dials the other peer by URL; no WebRTC.
Assumed exactly one active remote peer per session (true point-to-point).
Assumed X25519 ECDH + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM with local-only private keys.
Independent review failed the first handshake (no proof-of-possession); fixed with mutual AES-GCM proofs over a canonical transcript before closing.
Pre-mortem residual: TOFU MITM on first cleartext HTTP connect remains accepted for v0; listen_url is not bound into the transcript.
Follow-up instruction to manage the project with GraphPact confirms contract approval for this bootstrap change.

risk.rationale: Cryptographic identity, encrypted messaging, HTTP input parsing, and concurrent peer I/O.

acceptance.criterion: GraphPact 0.2.0 files are present and the checker reports its version.
ECDH session keys encrypt/decrypt successfully; tampered ciphertext and spoofed handshake proofs are rejected.
Two in-process peers complete authenticated handshake and exchange one encrypted message; spoofed handshake and foreign sender keys fail.
The Tauri Rust backend compiles with the chat commands linked.

execution.rationale: Greenfield walking skeleton plus handshake hardening share one integration path.

tasks.outcome: Copy GraphPact skill, checker, and agent instructions into the repository.
Implement identity, session crypto, HTTP peer endpoints, and PoP handshake tests.
Wire Tauri commands and a minimal chat UI to the peer core.
Record GraphPact evidence, independent review, and project management docs.

findings: Mutual ECDH proof-of-possession required on handshake; spoofed public keys without private key receive 401.
Inbound handshake hard-codes responder key direction; no trusted client initiator flag.
Residual accepted for v0: TOFU MITM on first cleartext HTTP connect; listen_url not bound into transcript; CORS allow-any on peer API.
